quota_not_comparable: Conditions cannot be verified; new baseline
quota_unavailable: Account quota unavailable; unknown is not zero.
quota_scope_note: Compared with the prior turn's card in this Task. Quota is shared across the account, includes other Tasks and may update late; this is not usage attributable to this turn.
quota_precision_note: Changes follow the source's displayed precision. An unchanged display does not mean no usage.
context_note: Shown in observed order for this turn; tokens are not allocated by setting.
context_partial: Only part of this turn's settings was observed; the change history may be incomplete.
pending_usage_note: The first request has not been persisted yet; Stop will settle available usage.
title: Codex turn usage report
incomplete: Partial evidence, not a complete total
card_note: Task total is the native parent counter; this turn covers usage from its start to the snapshot. Both exclude subagents. The separate combined subtotal includes saved, request-deduplicated subagent usage in this turn. Data may lag or be incomplete; work after the snapshot is excluded. Tokens are not quota or billing; unknown is not zero. Stop settlement is saved separately without rewriting this card.
child_card_note: Task total and turn delta cover only this subagent. Descendant usage is shown separately and added to the request-deduplicated subtotal. Data may lag or be incomplete; unknown is not zero. Tokens are not quota or billing. Stop settlement is saved separately without rewriting this card.
child_unavailable: Subagent data is incomplete; unknown is not zero
context_missing: No settings observed for this turn in the tail; current preferences are not substituted.
settings_heading: This turn's settings (tail observations, not token allocation)
pending: Pending: no usable Stop snapshot exists for this turn yet. This is not a completed usage report.
pending_note: Local code fills this page at turn end. Disabling reports, interruption, the duration threshold or a hook failure can leave it pending. Missing numbers do not mean zero usage.
failed: Automatic usage report unavailable; Task work can continue.
note_stop: This is a user-turn Stop snapshot, not proof the whole Task is complete; another hook may continue it.
child_note_stop: This is this subagent's Stop boundary snapshot; it does not prove the whole Task is complete.
note_usage: Parent usage uses the native turn counter or boundary differences; subagents use saved per-request records in this window. Both may lag and are not quota percentages or billing.
child_note_usage: This subagent uses its own native turn counter or boundary delta; descendants use saved per-request records in this window. These are not quota or billing.
note_counter: Counter resets or source changes remain unknown. Tail scans are bounded and cannot prove there were no unobserved resets.
note_subsets: Input includes cached tokens and output includes reasoning; subsets are not added again. Observed zero does not mean a free turn.
note_scope: Only this Task and linked descendants are included. Request timestamps determine the window; subagent lifetime totals are not added again.
note_children: Unfinished children, missing request records and scan limits remain incomplete. Reporting does not wait, force-stop or request continuation.
note_render: Fixed local Python rendering calls no model, requests no continuation and edits neither the assistant's answer nor source conversations.
task_report_note: Current cumulative tokens are an observed native counter, not a lifetime total or bill. The turn table contains only locally recorded receipts, newest first; missing, pending, reset, and truncated data remain partial. Cached input and reasoning output are subsets. Native quota is account-wide, not a Task charge.
note_completion: Parent usage ends at the selected turn’s explicit completion event. Subagent usage retains the original start-to-Stop window; subsequent turns are excluded. This is not proof the entire Task is finished.
child_note_completion: This subagent's usage ends at an explicit completion event for its turn. Descendants keep the original start-to-Stop window; this does not prove the whole Task is complete.
note_reconcile: A bounded background check can publish a completion revision after Stop, without a model call. Missing completion evidence leaves the Stop snapshot provisional. Inline cards keep their original snapshot; reopening the Task does not guarantee a refresh.
